perfil.title: Meet your hero
perfil.body: Use /perfil to see your hero sheet.

trivia.title: First trivia
trivia.body: Use /trivia and answer a question. Right or wrong, it counts!

missao.title: First mission
missao.body: Complete your first mission with J.A.R.V.I.S.

preferencias.title: Your preferences
preferencias.body: Use /cerebro preferencias to pick your optional roles.

capitulo1.title: Chapter 1: The call
capitulo1.body: Use `/missao iniciar primeiro-contato-1` and finish it with success. Each button is a choice, and the end of the scene says whether it worked.

capitulo2.title: Chapter 2: Metal trail
capitulo2.body: Use `/missao iniciar primeiro-contato-2`. Bring someone with the Join button or start alone; in a group, everyone votes.

capitulo3.title: Chapter 3: The sweep unit
capitulo3.body: Use `/missao iniciar primeiro-contato-3`. It is your first fight: Sentinel runs the combat and ULTRON sends the enemy.

poderes.title: Your powers
poderes.body: Use /heroi poderes to see what your hero can do.

announce.origins_body:
Beep! Every hero now has an **origin**: Mutant, Inhuman, Science, Technology, Mystic, Cosmic or Trained. It decides which powers each one can pick.

If you registered before, you are now a **Mutant**, with everything kept: codename, powers, level and sheet. Want another origin? Use **/heroi origem** — it works **only once**.

The sheet command is **/heroi**. `/mutante` is gone.
